```plato

// A log of discrete labeled occurrences. Times is nondecreasing and parallel
// to Labels.
type EventLog
    implements ITimeSampled
{
    Times: Array<Instant>;
    Labels: Array<String>;
}

// A label attached to a span of time: an annotation, a phase, an experiment
// stage.
type LabeledTimeInterval
{
    Interval: TimeInterval;
    Label: String;
}

//==
// # Policies

// How samples are interpolated when a series is resampled onto new times.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sample-rate_conversion)
type ResamplingPolicy = Nearest | Linear | CubicSpline | HoldPrevious | HoldNext;

// How missing values in a series or column are treated during computation:
// drop the sample (Skip), substitute zero (Zero), fill from neighbors
// (Interpolate), or repeat the previous value (Hold).
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Missing_data)
type MissingValuePolicy = Skip | Zero | Interpolate | Hold;
```
